opening.argument: The clearest purpose is instruction about handling a stressful customer-support call. The speaker says the video teaches a real scenario so viewers can prepare for such a call, including how to deal with a tough customer and work under pressure. The video then teaches useful words used during the exchange, while the transfer problem is used as an analogy rather than a request for participation. Even where the dialogue includes a phone-number request tied to looking up an account and system notes, and a verbal-password request that is refused, those details are presented within the instructional scenario. Nothing in the stated purpose asks viewers for money, credentials, or participation; the later explanation supports an educational purpose.
